errors.evidence: The image shows a donut chart, which is a type of pie chart with a hole in the center. Describing it simply as a pie chart omits this key structural detail.

errors.text_span: There are four distinct slices within the chart.
errors.evidence: The chart shows only three slices or categories. The description incorrectly identifies the central label "Task Type" as a slice.

errors.text_span: A smaller slice, colored blue, is labeled “Task Type,” and occupies approximately 12.8% of the total area.
errors.evidence: This description is incorrect in multiple ways. The blue slice is labeled "Article editing" and represents 4.1%. "Task Type" is the label in the center of the chart, not a slice label. The value 12.8% belongs to the yellow slice.

errors.text_span: An even smaller slice, colored yellow, is labeled “Headline generation,” representing roughly 4.1%.
errors.evidence: While the label and color are correct for this slice, the associated value is wrong. The yellow slice for "Headline generation" represents 12.8%, not 4.1%. The value 4.1% belongs to the blue "Article editing" slice.
The description completely omits the "Article editing" category (the blue slice representing 4.1%). It misidentifies this slice as "Task Type".

errors.text_span: The chart does not include a legend or percentage labels inside the slices
errors.evidence: This phrasing is misleading because it implies there are no percentage labels at all. The chart clearly shows percentage labels for each category, located outside the slices.
